vMatrix.notes: NO TRIO SYSTEM APPLIES. Erel Light has six fixed single-skill (one group: two-skill) enhancement cores, not randomly rolled three-skill trio nodes. maplestorywiki lists the complete set as: Core 1 Spear of Lugh Boost; Core 2 Fury of Roan Boost; Core 3 Sting of Roan Boost; Core 4 Spear of Light Boost; Core 5 Charge of Fionn Boost + Path of Fionn Boost; Core 6 Impulse of Chulainn Boost. Grandis Library's underlying page data carries the note that the V Matrix system was overhauled in V.269 and all skills are boosted; Erel Light released in v.269, so it has never used the trio-lottery model and no trio-pairing advice exists or is needed for this class. FACTUAL PER-LEVEL VALUES (maplestorywiki): Spear of Lugh Boost, Fury of Roan Boost and Sting of Roan Boost each give 2% final damage per level, with Max Targets +1 at level 20 and Ignored Enemy Defense +20% at level 40; Spear of Light Boost gives 3% final damage per level; Charge of Fionn Boost, Path of Fionn Boost and Impulse of Chulainn Boost each give 2% final damage per level with Critical Rate +5% at level 20. Boost node level cap is 60. METHOD NOTE FOR ANY RE-SCRAPE: the Primary/Secondary/Other tiers above are NOT present as text on the rendered Grandis page - they are colour-coded only, and were read out of the page's own underlying data object (primary indices [0,1,2], secondary [3,5], other [4] against its nodes array). Two separate automated text reads of the same page produced two different and both incorrect tier assignments. Do not derive these tiers from page text.

hexa.notes: ERDA LINK, NOT HEXA MATRIX. This is a hard branch in the data model: MapleStory Wiki's Erel Light page states plainly that for SHINE classes 6th job skills are unlocked and enhanced using Erda Link instead of the HEXA Matrix. Grandis Library's Erel Light page carries no HEXA section at all and its Other Resources block links an Erda Link Tracker and an Erda Link Progression sheet where other classes link HEXA material. Erda Link was introduced in the v.260 Stargazer update. ERDA LINK MECHANICS (maplestorywiki, page last edited 2026-07-05): six stone types, upgraded with Sol Erda and Sol Erda Fragments - Origin Stone (unlocked automatically at job advancement, enhances Skill Nodes); Ultimate Stone (enhances Mastery Nodes when Light Power is active); Skill Stone (enhances Boost and Common Nodes when connected Rush Stones are active); Boost Stone (conditional effects, requires Light Power); Rush Stone (bonus stats, and connects stones along paths); SHINE Stone (bonus stats equivalent to HEXA Stats). Light Power is toggled in the Erda Link UI and shows as a glowing area; the area grows as stones are unlocked, and a 6th job skill becomes usable when that area covers it. PLANNING CONSEQUENCE WORTH SURFACING TO USERS: SHINE Stone enhancement costs Meso on top of Sol Erda and Sol Erda Fragments, and a failed enhancement can REDUCE the stone's level. That is a risk profile HEXA Stat does not have, and any Erda Link planner must model it rather than treating SHINE Stones as deterministic. SCOPE AND TOTALS FROM EIKONAL'S SHEET: the full ordering runs to roughly 70 goals; only the first 15 are recorded above because only those could be read verbatim. The sheet's own totals are 1166 Sol Erda (its note says this excludes Janus and rush stones), 38187 fragments, and 133.890% total final damage gained. Its columns are SKILL, LEVEL, ERDA, FRAGS, CUMULATIVE FRAGS, FD (%), EFFICIENCY (FD%/100 FRAGS), so the ordering is a greedy sort on final damage per fragment - it is a cost-efficiency ranking, not a rotation or gameplay judgement, and unlock steps score near zero by construction because they buy access rather than damage. NAME ALLOWLIST FOR 6TH JOB (maplestorywiki/w/Erel_Light/Skills, page last edited 2026-09-09, i.e. the v.271 patch date): class-specific skills are Fall of Melin (master level 30, 360 second cooldown) and Radiant Spear (master level 30); Mastery skills are SHINE Spear of Lugh, SHINE Fury of Roan and SHINE Sting of Roan; Enhancement (boost) nodes are Eternal Light Boost, Sentinel Rise Boost, Eternal Guardian Boost and Destruction of Roan Boost; shared skills are Sol Janus (with Sol Janus: Dawn and Sol Janus: Dusk), Sol Hecate and Sol Hecate: Styx. Do not emit any 6th job node name outside this list.

gearingNotes: No exotic stat model. Erel Light is a conventional STR main / DEX secondary warrior - unlike Demon Avenger it has no HP-as-damage-stat quirk, and unlike Xenon it has no cross-branch gear decision. The class-specific gearing facts that ARE sourced, all from the skill tables at maplestorywiki.net/w/Erel_Light/Skills: SELF-SOURCED CRITICAL RATE IS LARGE. Named passive and buff sources are Radiant Shock (Critical Rate +15% at max), Radiant Dawn (Critical Rate +20% at level 10, +22% at level 12), and the Light Enchant buff (Critical Rate +10% at max, 200 second duration). Two hyper passives add a further +20% critical rate each but only to Fury of Roan and to Sting of Roan specifically, not globally. The individual values are recorded rather than summed because no source publishes an Erel Light critical rate target or states where investment should stop - that calculation is left to the reader rather than asserted here. SELF-SOURCED IGNORE DEFENSE IS ALSO LARGE. Radiant Control gives Ignore Defense +40% at level 15; Path of Fionn carries Ignore Defense +100% on the skill itself; the 6th job skill Radiant Spear carries Ignore Defense +60%, Boss Damage +40% and a flat 100% critical rate; boost nodes for Spear of Lugh, Fury of Roan and Sting of Roan each add Ignored Enemy Defense +20% at node level 40. BOSS DAMAGE FROM PASSIVES: Radiant Control gives Boss Damage +20% at level 15, before the Boss Rush hyper passive and the legion effect. SURVIVABILITY IS UNUSUALLY SELF-CONTAINED: Radiant Hold (Max HP +10%, damage taken -20%, knockback resistance +40%) and Radiant Will (Max HP +20%, damage taken -20%, knockback resistance +60%) stack, and Shield of Chulainn passively creates a barrier absorbing up to 30% of Max HP whenever Fury of Roan and Sting of Roan are comboed off Spear of Lugh - which the FAQ notes happens naturally in the normal attack loop. Max HP therefore has real defensive value on this class beyond survival floor. BUFF DURATION MATTERS MORE THAN AVERAGE: the class's own link skill grants Buff Duration +19%, and its two main buffs (Light Enchant, Helian Blessing) both run 200 seconds. ERDA LINK RESOURCE RISK: SHINE Stone enhancement consumes Meso in addition to Sol Erda and Sol Erda Fragments and can fail, lowering the stone's level - budget for that, unlike HEXA Stat.

conflicts.issue: Boost node tier versus per-level value for Spear of Light
conflicts.positionA: Grandis Library's page data classes Spear of Light Boost as Secondary, below Spear of Lugh, Fury of Roan and Sting of Roan.
conflicts.positionB: maplestorywiki's V Enhancement table gives Spear of Light Boost 3% final damage per level, the highest of any Erel Light node, while all three of Grandis's Primary nodes are listed at 2% per level.
conflicts.resolution: NOT RESOLVED. Both facts are recorded as stated. A plausible reconciliation is that the three Primary skills are cast far more often than the Spear of Light summon so absolute contribution differs from per-level rate, but no source says this and it is not asserted here.

conflicts.issue: Which 6th job skill is Origin and which is Ascent
conflicts.positionA: maplestorywiki lists exactly two class-specific 6th job skills, Fall of Melin (master level 30, 360 second cooldown) and Radiant Spear (master level 30), and labels neither as Origin or Ascent.
conflicts.positionB: Eikonal's Erda Link Progression sheet contains separate goal rows for Origin and for Ascent but refers to them only by those generic role names, never by skill name.
conflicts.resolution: NOT RESOLVED and deliberately not guessed. Any UI that needs to show an Origin or Ascent skill name for Erel Light must confirm the mapping from a source before displaying it.

conflicts.issue: Does a community 6th job build exist for Erel Light
conflicts.positionA: The Erel Light FAQ states outright that the community has not made a 6th job build yet.
conflicts.positionB: Eikonal's Erda Link Progression sheet is exactly such a build - a full ordered investment sequence with cost and efficiency per step - and Grandis Library links it from the Erel Light page.
conflicts.resolution: NOT RESOLVED because neither artifact carries a date. The likeliest explanation is that the FAQ statement predates the sheet and was never updated, but that is inference, not evidence. Consumers should treat the sheet as the current answer and the FAQ line as probably stale.

evidenceWarning: THE THREE-INDEPENDENT-SOURCES BAR IS NOT MET FOR ANY JUDGEMENT CLAIM IN THIS FILE, and the app must not present Erel Light advice with the confidence it gives a class like Bowmaster. Three independent sources exist for FACTS (maplestorywiki, the Erel Light FAQ, and Eikonal's Erda Link sheet), but every judgement field rests on exactly one: boost node tiering and hyper passives and training inner ability come only from Grandis Library, whose own credits block attributes the judgement fields to the Erel Light Discord; the Erda Link investment order comes only from Eikonal's sheet; the bossing inner ability lines appear in two places that share one community. There is no second opinion to check any of it against. Four structural reasons this class is worse-sourced than most: (1) it is roughly three months old, released in v.269; (2) Grandis Library links no Class Doc for it, meaning no maintained class guide document exists; (3) the FAQ that stands in for one self-describes as a placeholder; (4) because the class is GMS-exclusive, the NamuWiki / KMS cross-check lane that provides genuine independence for most classes does not exist at all. ADDITIONAL GAPS: reddit.com was not reachable in this pass, so r/Maplestory Erel Light discussion is entirely unexamined; the web search budget was exhausted, so no YouTube guide pass was run; and the Erel Light Discord itself - which the FAQ and both sheets all originate from - was not read. Anyone extending this file should start there.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: No skill or node name could be disproven; naming discipline is broadly sound and the refusal to guess the Origin/Ascent mapping is correct and confirmed (both rows exist unnamed in the sheet).

Terminology conflation: the sheet reads 'Eternal Guardian Skill Stone'; the file calls it 'Eternal Guardian boost stone' in four steps. The file's own Erda Link mechanics section defines Skill Stone and Boost Stone as distinct types, and its allowlist introduces a third name, 'Eternal Guardian Boost', as an Enhancement node. Three names, no disambiguation.

Unverified as discrete rows: the separate 'Unlock the M1 mastery' (50, eff 0.18) and 'Unlock the first Eternal Guardian boost stone' (100, eff 0.10) steps. The sheet's prerequisites appeared as rush stones at 0-2 Erda, not at these costs. Possibly real rows on a tab I could not read, possibly reconstructed.

Unverified names: 'Sol Hecate' and 'Sol Hecate: Styx' in the 6th job allowlist. The sheet says only 'Hecate'; maplestorywiki was unreachable (HTTP 403 on every route), so the 'Sol' prefix is uncorroborated.

Omission that alters the recommendation: the sheet's opening rows include Sentinel Rise Skill Stone L1 (efficiency 1.54) and Destruction of Roan Skill Stone L1, with Eternal Guardian at row 4 right after the masteries. Neither Sentinel Rise nor Destruction of Roan appears anywhere in the file's 15-step order, though Sentinel Rise's 1.54 outranks included steps SHINE Stone #2 (1.22) and M2 to level 3 (1.12). Caveat: gviz returns only the first sheet, so a tab difference could explain part of this.
